required_hits.description: The score threshold at which an email is considered spam.

report_safe.description: What happens to a message tagged as spam: 0 = add headers and keep the original, 1 = attach the original as message/rfc822 to a report, 2 = attach it as text/plain. (spamassassin --lint accepts 0, 1 and 2 and rejects 3 — measured on AlmaLinux 9.)

rewrite_header_subject.description: The text to prepend to the subject line of spam emails.
